Self.Wiki: This map object represents a treasure within the map.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part referenced by the treasure event.

ItemLotID.Wiki: The item lot to award when this treasure is acquired.

UncommonItemLotID.Wiki: A second item lot read together with the normal one. -1 for none (about half of the treasures).

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The animation ID the player uses when picking up this treasure. -1 on every treasure in the game files.

InChest.Wiki: The kind of treasure: 1 on almost every treasure (in a container), else 0, 3 or 4. Unknown: 0x42 only applies to kind 1.

Unk42.Wiki: If ON, the treasure also checks Unknown: 0x48, but only when Treasure Kind is 1, Unknown: 0x4A is 4, and a session condition holds. ON for 448 treasures.

Unk43.Wiki: Read by the game. ON for every treasure in the game files.

Unk44.Wiki: A third ID read together with the item lots, often the item lot's family + 500. -1 for none.

Unk48.Wiki: A value used by the Unknown: 0x42 check. -1 for none, else 10 to 170 in steps of 10.

Unk4A.Wiki: Read by the game; must be 4 for the Unknown: 0x42 check. 0 or 4 in the game files.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, this treasure is hidden by default.
